Description: Waveshare RP2350B development board with 3.49in 172x640 IPS capacitive touch display
Notes: The whole project runs on this one module. Everything below is already on it.

Description: USB-C data cable for flashing and serial debug output
Notes: Must be a data cable, not charge-only. Flashing and the debug console both go over USB CDC.

Description: 3.7V Li-ion cell with JST connector for untethered field use
Notes: Some listings of the module include a cell. Only needed to carry the device outdoors; it runs fine on USB power.

Description: Dual Cortex-M33 @ 150 MHz, 520 KB SRAM, no PSRAM
Notes: MCU. The 520 KB SRAM ceiling with no PSRAM is what drives the streaming-mel design.
Holds the firmware and both INT8 networks (291 KB of weights total).

Description: LCD + capacitive touch controller, QSPI display interface
Notes: Display on GPIO20-25/34-37, touch on a separate I2C bus (GPIO32/33, addr 0x3B).

Description: Low-power mono audio codec, I2S master
Notes: Drives MCLK/BCLK/WS. Mic data arrives on GPIO2. Control over I2C1 (GPIO6/7).
The only audio input. Sampled at 24 kHz to keep 7-9 kHz songbird calls intact.
Playback path only; not used by the recognition pipeline.
Present on I2C1 but deliberately unused.
Present on I2C1 but deliberately unused: no battery backup, so it loses the time.
Card slot is wired (SPI mode, GPIO26-31). Not required to run the device.
